question.text: Copper is extracted from copper pyrites ore by heating in a blast furnace. The method is based on the principle that

options.text: Copper has more affinity for oxygen than sulphur at high temperature.
Iron has more affinity for oxygen than copper at high temperature.
Sulphur has less affinity for oxygen at high temperature.
Copper has less affinity for oxygen than sulphur at high temperature.

solution.text:
Iron has greater affinity for oxygen than copper. Thus, the copper oxide reacts with iron sulphide to from iron oxide and reproduce copper sulphide.

FeS + Cu 2 O ⟶ FeO + Cu 2 S
